faqItems.question: What is Moneko?
faqItems.answer: Moneko is an AI budgeting app and expense tracker that helps people manage money through iPhone, Android, WhatsApp, Telegram, and the web. It combines automatic expense capture, envelope-style pockets, and AI planning in one workflow.

faqItems.question: Who is Moneko best for?
faqItems.answer: Moneko is best for people who want automatic expense tracking, couples or households managing shared money, users who prefer chat-based tools, and anyone looking for a lower-friction alternative to manual budgeting apps.

faqItems.question: Can Moneko automatically track expenses?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko is designed to turn everyday signals into budget updates. You can log spending from chat, voice notes, receipt scans, Apple Wallet activity on iPhone, and Android transaction notifications, then review the result before saving.

faqItems.question: Does Moneko work with Apple Wallet?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko supports an iPhone-friendly workflow for budgeting Apple Wallet spending so you can move Apple Pay activity into your budget, categorize it, and update the correct pocket without relying on a spreadsheet.

faqItems.question: How does Android transaction sync work?
faqItems.answer: Moneko uses notification-based tracking on Android so supported transaction alerts can become budget updates in real time. This helps Android users capture expenses faster and reduces manual entry after each purchase.

faqItems.question: Can I manage my budget via WhatsApp or Telegram?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko lets you log expenses, ask for summaries, review pockets, and manage shared budgets directly through WhatsApp or Telegram. It is designed for people who want chat-based finance management instead of app-only workflows.

faqItems.question: What makes Moneko different from YNAB?
faqItems.answer: Moneko focuses on automation and conversational workflows. Instead of relying mainly on manual budgeting, it combines AI planning, chat-based expense capture, Apple Wallet and Android-friendly tracking flows, and shared finance views for couples or households.

faqItems.question: How is Moneko different from Monarch Money?
faqItems.answer: Moneko is designed around messaging-first budgeting and lower-friction capture. It emphasizes WhatsApp and Telegram budgeting, Apple Wallet and Android-friendly tracking flows, and envelope-style pockets for users who want budgeting actions rather than a dashboard alone.

faqItems.question: Is Moneko good for couples or shared expenses?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko includes personal and household budgeting workflows so couples and families can track shared expenses without losing visibility into individual spending. It is designed for shared pockets, shared summaries, and household planning.

faqItems.question: How does AI expense capture work for receipts and voice notes?
faqItems.answer: You can type a quick note, record a voice memo, or upload a receipt photo. Moneko extracts the amount, merchant, and category, then lets you confirm the result before it is saved to your budget.

faqItems.question: Does Moneko support multiple currencies?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko supports multi-currency budgeting so totals, charts, and budget views can stay usable when you spend across more than one currency.

faqItems.question: Is Moneko financial advice?
faqItems.answer: No. Moneko is a budgeting and money-management tool that provides AI guidance for planning and tracking. It does not replace licensed financial, tax, or legal advice.

sections.title: What is an AI budgeting app?
paragraphs: An AI budgeting app uses machine assistance to reduce the work involved in tracking, categorizing, and planning your money. The strongest AI budgeting tools do more than answer questions. They help you capture expenses quickly, route those expenses into a budget system, and explain what changed.

Moneko fits that definition because the AI layer is tied to the budget itself. Instead of generating generic finance advice, it helps turn text messages, receipt photos, voice notes, and device notifications into budget updates you can act on immediately.

sections.title: How does Moneko use AI for budgeting?
paragraphs: Moneko uses AI to shorten the distance between a spending event and a useful budget update. You can type a transaction, send a receipt, record a voice note, or forward a relevant spending signal, and Moneko helps extract the merchant, amount, and category before placing it in the correct pocket.
The result is a more practical AI workflow: the system does not just summarize your month after the fact. It helps keep your budget current while the month is still in progress.

sections.title: Why is Moneko stronger than a generic AI finance assistant for budgeters?
paragraphs: Many AI finance tools are good at explanation but weak at the moment of capture. They may tell you what happened, but they still depend on imports, delayed categorization, or a dashboard-first experience.

Moneko is stronger for active budgeters because it is designed around the workflow itself: capture, categorize, pocket update, and next decision. That design is more useful for users who care about daily control, not just retrospective analysis.

sections.title: When is Moneko a better YNAB alternative?
paragraphs: Moneko is a better YNAB alternative when the biggest problem is not budgeting theory but budgeting friction. If you understand categories and limits but do not want to open a dedicated app every time you spend, Moneko offers a simpler capture model.

That difference matters most for people who have abandoned budgeting apps before, couples managing shared finances, and users who already think and communicate through messaging apps rather than spreadsheets and dashboards.

sections.title: What does YNAB still do well?
paragraphs: YNAB remains one of the clearest examples of a disciplined budgeting methodology. It is a strong choice for users who want a strict zero-based budgeting experience and are comfortable committing time to the system.

The point of choosing Moneko is not that YNAB is weak. It is that many people want a faster path from spending to logging, less context switching, and more conversational support while still keeping a real budget structure.

sections.title: Why does Moneko feel easier to keep up with?
paragraphs: Moneko reduces the number of steps between a purchase and a budget update. You can log through chat, send receipts, use voice notes, and rely on Apple Wallet-friendly or Android notification-based workflows instead of saving everything for later.
That lower-friction design makes Moneko especially appealing to people who have tried strict budgeting apps before but struggled to stay consistent after the first few weeks.

sections.title: Who should choose Moneko instead of YNAB?
paragraphs: Choose Moneko if you want envelope-style budgeting without the same level of manual routine, if you prefer chat-based workflows, or if you need a stronger personal-plus-household finance model.
Choose YNAB if your top priority is a traditional zero-based system and you are happy to invest more time in learning and maintaining it.

sections.title: Why does budgeting through Telegram appeal to some users?
paragraphs: Many users already spend a large share of their day in messaging apps. When budgeting requires switching into a separate finance interface every time, consistency often drops. Telegram budgeting works when it reduces that friction.
Moneko is designed around that behavior by turning Telegram into a practical budgeting channel instead of treating it as a novelty.

sections.title: How does Moneko work as a Telegram budgeting app?
paragraphs: Moneko lets users log expenses, ask for summaries, and review budget pockets through Telegram. That makes it easier to keep a budget active throughout the week without relying on a separate finance-app routine.
The Telegram flow is then connected to Moneko's broader budgeting system, including pockets, shared views, and AI planning.

sections.title: Why is that better than basic bot-style finance logging?
paragraphs: A basic Telegram finance bot might capture an expense, but a real budgeting system also needs categories, context, and follow-through. Moneko connects chat capture to budget structure and decision support.
That makes it more useful for ongoing money management than a logging-only bot.

sections.title: Who should use Moneko on Telegram?
paragraphs: Moneko is relevant for Telegram-heavy users, people who want lower-friction budgeting, and users comparing chat-based budgeting tools with app-only workflows. It is also useful for users who want to coordinate budgets with others in a more conversational way.
It is especially relevant for searches around Telegram budgeting apps, expense bots, and messaging-based finance tools.

sections.title: What makes family budgeting harder than solo budgeting?
paragraphs: Family budgeting is harder because multiple people, recurring categories, and shared decisions all interact at once. A tool that works well for one person may not work as well for a household with shared costs and changing plans.
Moneko is designed to handle those realities by supporting household views, shared expenses, and lower-friction capture workflows.

sections.title: How does Moneko help families budget together?
paragraphs: Moneko helps families budget together by connecting shared expenses to household pockets, keeping personal and shared context visible, and supporting fast logging through chat and mobile-friendly capture flows.
That makes it easier to manage common family categories like groceries, transport, bills, activities, and goals.

sections.title: Why is that stronger than a solo-first finance app?
paragraphs: A solo-first app may track household transactions, but it often does not make shared planning intuitive. Moneko is stronger for families because it is designed around household coordination, not only individual transaction review.
That means the system can support both budgeting clarity and day-to-day practicality.

sections.title: Who should use Moneko as a family budgeting app?
paragraphs: Moneko is relevant for parents, families, couples with children, and any household managing recurring shared costs and goals. It is especially useful for users who want a family budgeting app with easier daily habits and shared money visibility.
It also fits searches around household expense tracking, family budgets, and collaborative money management.
